name: Memory
author: ismoil
description: RAM in the bar, and a popup that tells calm from danger the way systemd-oomd does: the last 10 minutes, what RAM is made of, pressure and swap against oomd's kill lines, zram, the cache with a button to give it back, and the apps holding the most memory with their swap — open one to see its tabs or scripts, stop it in two clicks. Reads kernel files in place: no background processes. English and Russian, readable for low vision.

barWidget.description: RAM, pressure, swap and zram; apps you can open and stop

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Right click on the bar cycles it too.

schema.label: Warn when memory runs out
schema.description: One notification when pressure or swap nears systemd-oomd's kill line, at most every 10 minutes.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (Russian or English).

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Scales the popup text. Text is never smaller than 13 px.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Turn off to stop bars from sliding.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds, at least 2)
schema.description: How often the kernel's memory files are re-read. No process is started for it.
